usage.callShape: GET https://stableflowers.dev/api/products?category=<string>&count=<1-50> (siwx-signed; supply either category OR code query param)
usage.outputShape: body.products[] (each: code, name, price, description, image, categories[], dimensions), body.total
quirks: Despite registry surface showing price 'Varies' and a 402 probe, the GET call returns 200 FREE under siwx identity - no USDC is charged (it's auth-gated, not pay-gated).
MUST supply either ?category= or ?code= query param; with neither it returns HTTP 400 {success:false,error:'Provide either category or code.'} even though inputSchema marks all params optional.
Requires siwx wallet signature (authMode=siwx); call qa-pay with --siwx.

Test category values 'roses'/'bouquet' returned {products:[],total:0} - the exact category taxonomy is unknown; a fresh agent should discover valid category strings or use ?code= for a known product code.
Optional query params: count (1-50, default 12), start (pagination, default 1), sorttype (pa|pd|az|za).
usage.guide: Call GET https://stableflowers.dev/api/products with a siwx wallet signature (free - no USDC charged despite the registry probe showing 402). You MUST include either a ?category=<string> or ?code=<string> query param or the API returns HTTP 400 'Provide either category or code.' Read results from body.products[] (each has code, name, price, description, image, categories[], dimensions) and body.total. Use count (1-50), start, and sorttype (pa/pd/az/za) for paging and sorting. Valid category strings were not discovered during QA - empty arrays came back for generic guesses, so probe for the real taxonomy or use a known product code.
